name: Shinonome Lize
source:
"You know it! I've been baking muffins since dawn! Let's down 'em together at lunch, 'kay?"

A 16-year-old high schooler in Class 2-C.

Yuuki's best friend and a whiz in the kitchen. She's always baking up delectable treats.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/paradox/characters/]official website[/url]]
